dataset_name: Regional Kannada Dataset — Coastal Kannada source corpus
region_label_basis: The user designated this work as Coastal Kannada. The author/work is associated with Dakshina Kannada, but this does not establish that every sentence or lexical item is uniquely Coastal Kannada.
methodology: Narrative text was extracted from the supplied DOCX; front matter and running page/chapter headers were excluded where identifiable.
Sentence records were segmented using sentence-final punctuation. OCR line-breaks and punctuation may cause segmentation errors.
Paragraph records preserve extracted text blocks after normalizing line breaks.
Vocabulary entries are an initial curated list of colloquial, cultural, household, and rural expressions found in the text.
quality_and_limitations: The source DOCX is OCR-derived and contains visible OCR errors, so all records are marked unverified.
The novel is literary prose. Coastal setting/author association alone does not prove that every word or sentence is dialect-specific.
The vocabulary list is a candidate list, not a validated Coastal Kannada lexicon. Many items may be shared across Kannada varieties.
Do not treat all sentence/paragraph labels as confirmed dialect labels for model training without native-speaker review.
Page numbers are left null because the extracted DOCX pagination does not reliably map every text block to the printed book page.
recommended_next_steps: Have a Coastal Kannada speaker review each candidate expression and mark regional_specificity.
Add locality labels such as Kundapura, Udupi, Mangaluru, Puttur only when supported by the text or a knowledgeable annotator.
Correct OCR errors against page images before using the corpus for model training.
Split source-derived literary language from explicitly dialectal dialogue when annotation evidence permits.
